craft_notes: Sthāyin: joined-and-burned (full oblation). Rows: row 2 (yearly as landing: monthly-yearly closes). Close: yearly (repetition as landing: time-cycles close). Rejected: 'funeral' generic — kept joining (yojanikā as the act); trimming the calendar — kept monthly-yearly (the schedule IS the verse).

lines: Then, having joined with supreme Śiva, burn with the full oblation;
for the purified and the rest — or a three-day śrāddha-initiation, fourth day, monthly, yearly.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ paramaśive yojanikāṃ kṛtvā tat dahet pūrṇāhutyā antyeṣṭyā śuddhānām anyeṣām api vā śrāddhadīkṣāṃ tryahaṃ turye dine māsi māsi saṃvatsare saṃvatsare kuryāt

reads_against.argmap: What then? → Joining done, burning done, on schedule: third-day śrāddha-initiation, monthly, yearly.
c1_essence: Joining with supreme Śiva, burning with full oblation; for purified and others — or three-day śrāddha-initiation, monthly, yearly.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with karuṇa undertow (quiescence carrying compassion) (śama with karuṇā (quiescence with compassion))
